gloss: extending a stay by extra nights

definitions.gloss: to extend one's stay; to stay extra nights
definitions.explanation: To add nights to a booking already made, staying on past the original checkout date. Standard vocabulary at hotel front desks and on booking sites, whether the reason is a delayed flight or simply wanting more time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一泊|いっぱく}→一泊：08892_ippaku⟧{延泊|えんぱく}⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧。
examples.english: I'd like to extend my stay by one night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠航|けっこう}→欠航：09509_kekkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、{延泊|えんぱく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: The typhoon caused my flight to be cancelled, so I ended up extending my stay.

examples.japanese: {延泊|えんぱく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: In the case of an extended stay, the rate may differ.

examples.japanese: ⟦{満室|まんしつ}→満室：15726_manshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{延泊|えんぱく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{断|ことわ}り→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、お⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦フロント→フロント：01378_furonto⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧ご⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: We may have to decline an extension if we are fully booked, so please speak to the front desk as early as you can.

notes:
{延|えん} (extend) + {泊|はく} (night's lodging). The number of added nights goes before the word: ⟦{一泊|いっぱく}→一泊：08892_ippaku⟧{延泊|えんぱく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {延泊|えんぱく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to extend one's stay
- {延泊|えんぱく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to request an extension
- {延泊料金|えんぱくりょうきん}: the rate for extra nights
- {延泊|えんぱく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧: extension is possible

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{連泊|れんぱく}→連泊：07049_renpaku⟧: consecutive nights — several nights booked as one stay from the outset, not added later
- ⟦{宿泊|しゅくはく}→宿泊：03216_shukuhaku⟧: lodging; staying overnight — the general term
